name: Permanent Residence for Investors

requirements.blocker_text: A foreign investor who has contributed at least EUR 150,000 may apply directly for PERMANENT residence (not merely temporary residence), under Article 50 of the Law on Legal Status of Foreign Citizens.

evidence_required.document: Proof of investment amount and channel

outcome.duration_length: indefinite; holder must remain in-country at least 183 days/year or face annulment

sources.title: LegislationLine -- Law on Legal Status of Foreign Citizens and Persons without Citizenship in the Republic of Belarus, Article 50: EUR 150,000+ investment qualifies for direct permanent residence, alongside a separate discretionary route for 'unique abilities and talent or outstanding merits' in science, culture, or sports

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Belarus). STATUS: DRAFT -- the EUR 150,000 figure and the direct-to-permanent-residence structure are both stated in the tier-1-hosted legislative text, but this is a country under significant Western sanctions with restricted capital flows and banking access for many nationalities, so the PRACTICAL usability of this route for applicants from sanctioning countries could not be assessed in this pass -- flagged as a real-world caveat separate from the legal text itself. A parallel discretionary route for individuals with 'unique abilities and talent or outstanding merits' in science, culture, or sports also grants permanent residence under the same Article 50 -- not modeled as a separate route here since it has no stated objective threshold, only mentioned for completeness.
